title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Blue Razz Lemonade Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Blue Razz Lemonade blends sweet Blue Raspberry-style flavour with a sharp Lemonade twist. The result is a bright, punchy fruit-and-citrus mix with a gentle cool note on the exhale that keeps it tasting clean and lively. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod is supplied as a single prefilled 2ml pod linked to an integrated 10ml refill reservoir, giving 12ml total of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. There’s no messy topping up and no coil swaps. Just attach it to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and vape. The pod uses a dual mesh coil and draw-activated inhale to support clear flavour and discreet MTL vapour. A single pod can deliver up to 6000 puffs (approx.), depending on personal use. When taste fades or the reservoir runs dry, fit a fresh Blue Razz Lemonade pod. Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
